# SARKAR ORION

> SARKAR is a unisex parfum house by Bhuvan Bam. ORION is its fresh, citrus, aromatic unisex parfum — "Infinite. Cold. Ambitious." — a 100ml parfum with 25% oil concentration, priced at ₹1,499 (inclusive of all taxes).

## This site

- [ORION product page](https://orion-ambition-page.lovable.app/): Flagship landing page for SARKAR ORION 100ml — scent composition (top: lemon, citrus spark, cold air; heart: lavender, mineral mist, blue aromatics; base: cedarwood, musk, sandalwood), gallery, details and purchase.

## Official SARKAR store

- [Shop All](https://www.sarkar.store/collections/shop-all): Full SARKAR parfum collection.
- [Noble](https://www.sarkar.store/products/noble): Woody, spiced amber, warm — 100ml, ₹1,499.
- [Throne](https://www.sarkar.store/products/throne-100ml-perform): Leather, oud, commanding — 100ml, ₹2,499.
